bias.en: Bearish · rejected at the 100 and 200-day, back near $600
bias.zh: 看空 · 在 100 日和 200 日均线受阻，回到 $600 附近

read.en: Meta fell 4.0% on Nov 5 to $605.08, trading between $583.80 and $634.99. It is below the falling 5-day ($615.6) and 10-day ($620.8), the rising 200-day ($632.1) and 100-day ($633.3), and the falling 30-day ($689.0) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 2 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 16 ($643.09), and RSI is 35.
read.zh: Meta 11月5日下跌 4.0%，收于 $605.08，盘中区间 $583.80–634.99。股价位于下行的 5 日（$615.6）和 10 日均线（$620.8）、上行的 200 日（$632.1）和 100 日均线（$633.3）以及下行的 30 日均线（$689.0）下方。MACD 自 10月2日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月16日起看空（$643.09），RSI 为 35。

read.en: The rebound reversed: the $634.99 high stalled at the 100 and 200-day, and the close lost the $606.4–626.4 supports; the $583.8 low undercut the $592.6–601.2 lows before the close recovered above them. Resistance is $606.4–610.1 (Nov 2, Oct 30 and Nov 3 lows), then $615.6–620.8 (5 and 10-day) and $632.1–635. Support is $600–601.2, then $592.6–594.8 (May lows) and $583.8. A close above $610.1 would target $616–621; below $600, $593.

r.en: Nov 2 low $606.4; Oct 30 and Nov 3 lows $610.1, lost

s.en: Jan 20 and Apr 30 lows $600; Nov 7, 2025 low $601.2
